title: Passage 39
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: As a country powerful in maths, China has many creative folk games full of maths wisdom.
sentences.cn: 作为数学强国，中国有许多充满数学智慧的创意民间游戏。

sentences.en: You may play them during a sunny afternoon or on a vacation abroad.
sentences.cn: 你可以在阳光明媚的午后或出国度假时玩这些游戏。

sentences.en: Let's take a look at three of them.
sentences.cn: 让我们来看看其中的三个吧。

sentences.en: Chinese Nine Linked Rings Puzzle
sentences.cn: 中国的九连环

sentences.en: It's believed that the Nine Linked Rings puzzle was created in the Western Han Dynasty and may have been played even by the emperor himself.
sentences.cn: 相传九连环是在西汉时期创造的，甚至有可能皇帝自己都会玩。

sentences.en: It is usually made up of nine rings connected to a handle.
sentences.cn: 它通常由九个圆环连接到一个手柄上组成。

sentences.en: Players have to remove all the rings from the handle to win the game.
sentences.cn: 玩家必须将所有的环从手柄上取下，才算赢得游戏。

sentences.en: This is not a simple game.
sentences.cn: 这可不是一个简单的游戏。

sentences.en: The solution takes 341 moves.
sentences.cn: 解法需要341步。

sentences.en: So lots of effort is required.
sentences.cn: 因此需要付出很多努力。

sentences.en: But if you learn to solve it, you'll probably never forget.
sentences.cn: 但是，如果你学会了怎么去解它，你可能就再也不会忘记了。

sentences.en: Tangram
sentences.cn: 七巧板

sentences.en: The tangram is a puzzle made up of seven pieces of different shapes, including a square, a parallelogram, and five triangles.
sentences.cn: 七巧板是由七块不同形状的板子组成的拼图游戏，板子包括一个正方形、一个平行四边形和五个三角形。

sentences.en: Players need to use all the pieces to make a shape.
sentences.cn: 玩家需要用上所有的板子去拼出一个形状。

sentences.en: In the 18th century, the tangram was brought to the West and soon gathered international attention.
sentences.cn: 18世纪，七巧板被带到西方，很快引起了国际关注。

sentences.en: Today, you can play it on a computer screen or over the Internet.
sentences.cn: 现在，你可以在电脑屏幕或互联网上玩七巧板。

sentences.en: Luban Lock
sentences.cn: 鲁班锁

sentences.en: It is said that the Luban Lock was first created by Lu Ban,
sentences.cn: 相传，

sentences.en: who was a famous engineer in ancient China.
sentences.cn: 鲁班锁由中国古代著名工匠鲁班首创。

sentences.en: The lock has a lot to do with solid geometry.
sentences.cn: 鲁班锁与立体几何有很大关系。

sentences.en: It's hard to separate the six pieces.
sentences.cn: 鲁班锁的六块部件很难分开。

sentences.en: However, it is usually easier to unlock a Luban lock than to fix it back together.
sentences.cn: 不过，通常情况下，打开鲁班锁要比复原它容易得多。

sentences.en: Many people like to collect different kinds of Luban locks, considering them as treasures of Chinese culture.
sentences.cn: 许多人喜欢收集各种类型的鲁班锁，将其视为中国文化的瑰宝。
